definitions: A phrase used to express that if desires alone could make things happen, they would.
Emphasizes the futility of merely wishing for something without action.
examples: If wishes had wings, I'd be on a beach right now.
He keeps saying he wants to be rich, but if wishes had wings, we'd all be millionaires.
If wishes had wings, my garden would be weed-free.
synonyms: if wishes were horses, beggars would ride
